notes.title: SNIPER ELITE V2 REMASTERED Launches May 14th - Upgrade Discount Confirmed
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34794722/b938a9df5da091198e4c7013030e0d0ae77678e3.jpg[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nKB1ioeA988

[h1]Independent developer and publisher Rebellion today announced an official release date for Sniper Elite V2 Remastered on Steam.[/h1]

The hotly anticipated remaster of the studio’s 2012 classic will launch on digital storefronts May 14th. Fans can pre-order [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] from today and take advantage of a special [b]10% discount[/b] on the digital edition ahead of launch.

[h1][u]Discount for owners confirmed![/u][/h1]
We are delighted to reveal that Steam users who already own the original edition of Sniper Elite V2 can upgrade to [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] for just [b]£6.99/$9.99/€9.99[/b].

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] features beautifully updated environments, characters, weapons and vehicles, modernized rendering and post-processing effects, enhanced texturing and level geometry, a revamped lighting system, and dozens upon dozens of improvements and refinements. 

In addition to visual upgrades, [b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] introduces a brand new frame-by-frame photo mode, seven new playable characters from Rebellion’s Zombie Army series, expanded multiplayer for up to 16 players online, and all the additional content ever released for the game, [b]FREE[/b]. 

[b]Sniper Elite V2 Remastered[/b] is available to pre-order from today for [b]£29.99/$34.99/€34.99,[/b] with a special [b]10% discount[/b] until launch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/728740/Sniper_Elite_V2_Remastered/

notes.title: LAUNCH TRAILER - STRANGE BRIGADE ENLISTS FREE FIFTH CHARACTER AT LAUNCH!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7576520/56e988f7137a6e835ab1e60639d9877faa0fe868.jpg[/img]

Would-be adventurers who acquire STRANGE BRIGADE when it launches next week will discover a rather resplendent treat – a FREE FIFTH CHARACTER!

Unveiled at the conclusion of today’s terrifically thrilling launch trailer, the gentleman explorer Winston Bey is now part of the Brigade! AND he’s FREE to all players who pre-order or purchase STRANGE BRIGADE on any platform during the first 30 days after launch.

[h1]Watch launch trailer[/h1] [url]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZoDmSD_aBAI[/url]

Prospector, journalist, spy, diplomat and traveller – Winston Bey has explored the world and seen it all. He tells himself the Brigade’s adventures are “just an amusing diversion” in his extensive voyages, but the Department of Antiquities already has longer-term employment in mind…

STRANGE BRIGADE is so close you can practically taste the Earl Grey! Today’s splendid launch trailer heralds its arrival on August 28th, when Rebellion’s astounding adventure for 1-4 players launches for PC.

notes.title: NEW STRANGE BRIGADE TRAILER TEASES POST-LAUNCH PANACHE!
notes.content:
The [b]STRANGE BRIGADE[/b] will soon set off in search of peril, but their daring exploits won’t end at launch… A brand new trailer released today showcases some of the ripping post-launch content coming to Rebellion’s debonair third-person adventure!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NbY4c_t_4qQ
Indeed, escapades will escalate with the introduction of [u]free monthly content[/u] – stay tuned for more details! And the stupendous [b]STRANGE BRIGADE SEASON PASS[/b] will introduce lashings of brand new excitement, all at a great-value price!

The [b]SEASON PASS[/b] includes:
[list]
[*]An intriguing new three-part mini-campaign, with amazing spectacles and incredible feats! 
[*]Brave new heroes from across the globe, complete with their own inimitable abilities!
[*]Brand new wonderful weapons, outrageous outfits, amazing amulet powers and more!
[*]And yes, that’s right, all future [b]STRANGE BRIGADE[/b] content!
[/list]
Players can pre-order the [b]STRANGE BRIGADE DELUXE EDITION[/b] now, featuring the game and season pass in a great value-for-money bundle. All [b]STRANGE BRIGADE[/b] pre-orders include the Secret Service Weapons Pack [b]FREE[/b], which includes the Wilkers & White P19 pistol, Stoudenmire 960 submachine gun and the Gehrig-Delgane S1 rifle.

notes.title: Zombie Army Trilogy Multiplayer Update - Public Lobbies
notes.content:
Being able to join a public Zombie Army Trilogy game with your friends has always been a hugely requested feature from you, the community.

Well now you can!

[b]Update Includes:[/b]
[list]
[*]The ability to create and join open (public) games with your friends
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who has given feedback on this since launch and the recent surveys. See you in game!

notes.title: First Update NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
The first patch for Zombie Army Trilogy has just been passed by our QA team and is rolling out on Steam right now!

[h1]PATCH 1 - 31st March 2015[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The ability to toggle aiming down sights or scope view.
[*]In-game scoreboard can now be toggled on and off.
[*]Improvements to track down matchmaking issues.
[*]Improved various Zombie stuck/lost progression blockers.
[*]Chat box is now hidden during cutscenes.
[*]Fixed rare crash that can occur when player is killed when dying or being revived.
[*]Fixed issue where you could still hear the Super Elite’s weapon audio even though he had stopped firing on death.
[*]Players will now correctly see level completion screen.
[*]Fixed bug where players were not able to use weapons and items.
[*]Various graphical updates and fixes.
[*]Other small fixes and updates.
[/list]
Many thanks to everyone who’s sent us constructive feedback or chatted with us in the community forums!
